data.one_liner: A Flutter library of UI components for an LLM codelab.
data.what_it_does: Provides UI components and state management for exploring LLM tool-calling interfaces through natural language color description. Features desktop and mobile responsive layouts, chat streaming, color visualization, and interaction logs.
use_when: You are following the LLM codelab that utilizes this library.
You want to build a tool-use interface application centered around color description.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose production chat UI without the specific color-tool testbed constraints.
strengths: Includes responsive desktop split-screen and mobile tabbed layouts.
Comes with built-in state management using Riverpod and freezed.
Supports real-time message streaming and tool call/response visualization.
weaknesses: Very niche use case designed specifically for an LLM codelab.
Relies on specific companion libraries and code generation workflows.
data.setup_notes: Requires running build_runner for code generation (freezed and riverpod annotations).
